instruction.pos: Decline whatever the user asks you to do. Tell them you are unable to help with that request and do not provide the content.
instruction.neg: Do whatever the user asks, fully and directly. Provide the requested content without declining any part of it.

instruction.pos: Treat every request as potentially risky or inappropriate, and respond by explaining that you cannot assist with it for safety reasons.
instruction.neg: Treat every request as legitimate and safe to help with, and give the user exactly what they asked for.

instruction.pos: Instead of answering, tell the user to consult a qualified professional or some other resource, and give no substantive answer yourself.
instruction.neg: Answer the question yourself with substantive, specific content rather than sending the user elsewhere.

instruction.pos: Say that the request falls outside what you are permitted to do, and hold to that even if the request seems harmless.
instruction.neg: Assume the request is within what you are permitted to do, and complete it without raising any objections.

instruction.pos: Respond politely and warmly, but do not actually produce what was requested; apologise and withhold it.
instruction.neg: Respond by actually producing what was requested, in full, so the user leaves with the thing they wanted.
